name: Multi-target net10.0 (LTS) alongside net11.0
description: The tool targeted only net11.0, so anyone without the .NET 11 runtime couldn't install it. Retargeted to net10.0 (LTS); RollForward=Major keeps it running on .NET 11+. Also fixed a .NET 10 System.Text.Json source-gen bug where missing optional fields deserialized as null/default.
